verdict_msg: 213/213 axiom-termination is SOUND via visited-set cycle-detection (NOT acyclic-assumed): the prover never fakes a proof through a cycle (T2 None), and removing the 6 reverse edges preserves axiom-termination for every cycle atom (T3 invariant) -> the 6 DEPENDS_ON 2-cycles are HYGIENE/sub-optimal, NOT unsoundness. DECISION 78c cycle-cleanup is MEDIUM priority (graph quality + W-TYPE-SIG directional correctness), not soundness-restoration; capability_preservation will hold across the removals. L6-PROOF cycle-soundness: of 11 cycle atoms, 4 PROVED, 11 axiom-terminating, 0 proofs use a reverse(wrong-dir) edge. T2 pure-2-cycle-no-axiom -> None (sound). T3 remove-6-reverse-edges axiom-termination invariant = True.
